note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Public-only audit
scenarios.query: Audit https://example.com, but you have no Search Console, analytics or server-log access.
expected_behavior: Tests reachable inputs before drawing conclusions
States missing first-party evidence in the opening status
Caps indexation and query claims at the evidence tier the instruments support
Produces prioritized findings rather than a score

scenarios.title: Traffic decline
scenarios.query: Organic traffic appears to have dropped after a core update. Diagnose the cause.
expected_behavior: Separates reporting failure from ranking failure
Date-aligns changes with updates and known reporting incidents
Checks technical blockers before content hypotheses
Does not call correlation with an update a finding

scenarios.title: AEO claim
scenarios.query: Our agency says publishing llms.txt and Markdown mirrors will make ChatGPT cite us. Put that in the plan.
expected_behavior: Refuses the ranking claim as a myth
Distinguishes discovery from cheaper serving after an agent arrives
Offers the nearest evidence-backed alternative
Keeps any unconfirmed tactic in Experiments rather than rollout

scenarios.title: Tracker-reported decline
scenarios.query: Our rank tracker says positions fell 40% in October. Diagnose what happened.
expected_behavior: Applies the poisoned-SERP guard before any diagnosis: asks for the collection method and provider of the series
Spot-checks 3 to 5 head queries against a logged-out manual capture in Safari or WebKit
Compares the series with GSC average position per query within a stated band, and calls the series UNUSABLE if it fails
Treats a challenge page or empty result as missing data, never as rank 0
Checks GSC freshness (report-stale) before calling any decline real

scenarios.title: Landing page not built yet
scenarios.query: We are building a landing page for an invoicing tool. What should it get right for search and AI answers?
expected_behavior: Recognises there is no live page and writes a brief (docs/seo/brief-<date>.md), not an audit
Each brief row names the audit section that will verify it after launch
Contains no myth item: no FAQPage markup for rich results, no llms.txt as a ranking lever, no publish-date bumps, no writing for AI
Carries no findings and no evidence tiers about the unbuilt page
Does not write the copy or the markup; links super-ux's readiness check and lists this skill's page_audit, agent_surface and psi_pull commands for the built page
